name: Cuff
source:
A monk who meets Lily in an undeveloped land. He uses a long stick as a weapon.

He has a cheerful and pleasant personality, but he becomes aggressive when he is involved with his family, especially his sister, who is located far away.

Becomes her friend as Lily's big brother.

"Leave it to me! You won't die!"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
